inferenceSummary: The PM-corrected R2 background is a full-frame reconstruction for the fixed side/down drink camera: continuous interior timber architecture, shelving, storage, trim, lights, and only the empty workspace surfaces needed behind later layers on both sides. It contains no exterior opening, does not reuse the mixed concept master directly, and contains no dynamic station, person, body part, UI, or semantic information.
